title: The MX Modular.
lead: An analog mixing console with 16 channels: channels 1–8 with 500 series slots and input selection, channels 9–16 as four stereo pairs, two stereo AUX sends and two stereo busses, two FX engines, a programmable mute controller and an 18 in / 18 out USB interface.
specs: Two engines on AUX 1 and AUX 2

panels.heading: Find your way around the console

items.name: Channel control
items.label: MX-F-101 / 102
items.text: ON, SOLO, pan, AUX sends, routing buttons, crossfader assign and fader for channels 1–8.

items.name: 500 series slots
items.text: Slots for 500 series modules on channels 1–8, with a bypass per slot.

items.name: Input selection and insert
items.text: Input selectors, USB post fader and channel inserts for channels 1–8.

items.name: FX module
items.text: Two independent effect engines, pre-routed to AUX 1 and AUX 2.

items.name: Inputs 9–16 and digital master
items.text: Four stereo pairs and the USB digital master return.

items.name: AUX and BUS
items.text: Send and return levels for the stereo AUXes and busses.

items.name: Monitor section
items.text: Master fader, monitor level, headphones and external input.

items.name: Mute controller
items.text: 9 banks of 4 mute groups for all 16 channels.
